title: Payment Extension Forgiveness Relief — Program Fact Sheet Clause

# Payment Extension Forgiveness Relief — Program Fact Sheet Clause

**Clause.** For a Payment Extension — the single-installment kind of Payment Arrangement — enrolled on a residential agreement under disconnection notice, the forgiveness relief rewards a customer whose Arrearage Management Program bills have recently earned forgiveness:

| Forgiveness entries posted on the customer's plans within the 6 months before enrollment | Forgiveness relief |
|---|---|
| 6 or more | 10% |
| At least 4 but fewer than 6 | 5% |
| Fewer than 4 | 0 |

The entries counted are the forgiveness entries on all of the customer's Payment Arrangement plans. A window of 6 months before enrollment covers entries dated after the same calendar day 6 months earlier, up to and including the enrollment date.

## Boundary readings (hypothetical)

| Forgiveness entries in the window | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6 | 7 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Forgiveness relief | 0 | 5% | 5% | 10% | 10% |
